_comment: Primitives Language_Repository feature-config.json for the MPL Java server.
The union of supportedFeatures + unsupportedFeatures equals the commons
Feature_Catalog [aes-gcm, hkdf, kbkdf-ctr-hmac, digest, hmac, ecdsa, random].
kbkdf-ctr-hmac is unsupported: the Java AtomicPrimitives KdfCounterMode builds
its fixed input from a required purpose+nonce (SHA-256/384 only, ikm 32/48/66,
expectedLength 32/64) and cannot consume the model's verbatim info blob.
